liebermann.description_de: Ingulf's ms. veterrimum aus Crowland, gedruckt von Spelman (Concilia 1639)
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Pseudo-Ingulf’s “very old manuscript” from Crowland, now lost; printed by Henry Spelman (Concilia, 1639)
liebermann.notes: Spelman printed from Ingulf's 'very old manuscript', of the 14th/15th century, from Crowland and perhaps the exemplar of Im, only five chapters of Leis Wl. MS Paris was copied from Isp.

entries.text_de:
Spelman9 druckte nach Ingulf's ms. veterrimo, also des 14./15. Jhs., aus Crowland, vielleicht der Vorlage von Im, nur fünf Capitel der Leis Wl.

Aus Isp copirte Hs. Paris.
entries.text_en:
Spelman9 printed, from Ingulf's ms. veterrimo, thus of the 14th/15th century, from Crowland, perhaps the exemplar of Im, only five chapters of the Leis Wl.

MS Paris was copied from Isp.

proof_notes: text_en: 'From Isp MS Paris copied.' → 'MS Paris was copied from Isp.'
